name: Plyometrics
goal: Vertical jump of baseline + X cm (wall-touch)

tests.name: Vertical jump (wall-touch)
tests.note: Best of 3, same warm-up each time. You set X after seeing the baseline.

stages.name: Tendon base and landing
stages.work: Slow single-leg heel raises (3 s down), Achilles isometric holds, ankle mobility, low stick landings (20–30 cm), skipping; ≤ 40 contacts
ready: 3 × 12 single-leg heel raises, 3 s down, pain-free

stages.name: Double-leg elastic
stages.work: Double-leg pogos (short, stiff contacts), squat jumps, broad jumps, low box jumps; ≤ 60 contacts
ready: 3 × 5 box jumps to 40 cm, landings stuck

stages.name: Single-leg elastic
stages.work: Single-leg pogos, in-place and lateral hops, low hurdle hops; ≤ 80 contacts
ready: 20 continuous single-leg pogos per leg with short contacts (film it)

stages.name: Bounds and reactive
stages.work: Alternate-leg bounds, reactive hurdle hops (30 cm), single-leg box jumps; ≤ 100 contacts
ready: 5 reactive hurdle hops with minimal ground time
5 single-leg box jumps per leg to 30 cm

stages.name: Depth jumps
stages.work: Drop jumps from 20 → 30 → 40 cm (use the height where the rebound is highest), countermovement jumps with arm swing; ≤ 100 contacts, ≤ 30 of them depth
ready: 5 depth jumps with a rebound at least as high as your countermovement jump

stages.name: Approach jumps
stages.work: 3–5 step approach, single-leg take-off to a touch target; ≤ 60 maximal contacts
ready: Vertical jump ≥ baseline + X cm, retested every 4 weeks
